product.description: The DreamCloud 3‑Piece Crib Bedding Set offers a gentle, breathable sleep environment for newborns and infants. Each set includes a fitted sheet, flat sheet, and a lightweight blanket crafted from certified organic cotton and a soft polyester blend. The breathable fabric promotes airflow while the hypoallergenic construction reduces irritation. Designed to fit standard 120 cm × 60 cm cribs, the bedding provides snug coverage and easy laundering. The set’s muted blue hue and subtle embroidered motif add a touch of calm to nursery décor. Ideal for parents seeking eco‑friendly, safe bedding for their little ones.
